level.title: LEVEL UP
talk.man0.1:
* I don't know how you got here.
* But welcome all the same.
talk.man1.1:
* Looking for something?
* There are no secrets here, I'm afraid.
talk.man1.2: * Just me. Alone. Behind this tree.
talk.man2.1: * Maybe you would like to hear a story.
talk.man2.2:
* There was a child with a decent life ahead of them.
* Loving parents. A brother. Friends.
talk.man2.3:
* Then one day tragedy struck.
* Nothing was ever the same after that.
talk.man2.4:
* Their parents separated, and the friends they
  held close drifted away.
talk.man2.5:
* They want to go back to the time before it.
* They can't. None of us can.
talk.man2.6:
* But we can choose not to forget the good
  that came before.
talk.man2.7: * We can carry it with us, and keep going.
talk.man3.1:
* (The man behind the tree had made his peace,
  and vanished.)
onlineHelp.p1.title: ONLINE CO-OP
onlineHelp.p1.body:
Fight the waves together - up to {0} of you.

One of you HOSTS and runs the game.
Everyone else JOINS and fights alongside.

You share the wave counter and the boss,
but you each keep your own health and super meter.

Friends can drop in after the run has begun.
onlineHelp.p2.title: SETTING IT UP
onlineHelp.p2.body:
HOST - pick HOST GAME, then send your friends
your IP address. Over the internet you must
forward TCP port {0} on your router first.

JOIN - pick JOIN GAME, type the host's IP,
then press ENTER.

If the host reports a different port because
{0} was busy, join with   IP:PORT

On the same house network, use the host's
local IP and skip the port forwarding.
onlineHelp.p3.title: WHAT CHANGES
onlineHelp.p3.body:
Dying does not end the run. You drop out for
a few seconds, then respawn with half health.
The enemies turn on whoever is still standing,
so the run only ends if EVERYONE is down.

TIME STOP is switched off online - it
rewrites the whole world, which only works
when one player owns it.

You will see everything your friend throws
out - bullets, arrows, slashes, the yoyo,
the thrown hammer and every SUPER.
